integrity: The findings are new calculations on a source model; the source numerical observations and general equilibrium theorems are expressly credited. Reproducibility is via a self-contained Python checker.
scientific_limitations: Specific symmetric two-station continuum EV game with uniform locations and energy, original approximate queue cost, zero choice noise, near critical arrival rate; no stochastic queue limit or independent priority certification.
title: Exact saturation law for heterogeneous electric-vehicle charging equilibrium
